description:
**Phase E — Compaction orchestration. Deps: E1, B6.**

Implement the `api.compact/1` body (currently stubbed at `apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/api.ex:27`).

Sequence:
1. Build `%CompactionPreparation{}` via `Compaction.prepare/2` (C5).
2. Emit `:session_before_compact` event (cancel-on-result pattern). Honor:
   - `{:cancel, reason}` → abort, no entry written.
   - Extension-supplied `%CompactionResult{}` → skip LLM call; entry will be written in E5b with `from_hook?: true`.
3. Otherwise call `Compaction.compact/2` (E1/E2).

Tests: port `compaction-extensions.test.ts` and `compaction-extensions-example.test.ts`. Verify existing `apps/octo_pi_coder/test/octo_pi/coder/extension/compaction_extensions_test.exs` still passes.
title: E4. Session.compact/2 + :session_before_compact dispatch
